real.mp-api-ticket-invalid.json: Body of GET https://api.mercadopublico.cl/servicios/v1/publico/licitaciones.json?estado=activas with an invalid ticket (HTTP 203)
real.lic-da-2025-7.head.csv: First 200 records of lic_2025-7.csv in https://transparenciachc.blob.core.windows.net/lic-da/2025-7.zip, Latin-1, cut at record boundaries, natural persons, emails and phones scrubbed
real.oc-da-2025-7.head.csv: First 150 records of 2025-7.csv in https://transparenciachc.blob.core.windows.net/oc-da/2025-7.zip plus the 4 July 2025 rows listed in hist_OC_erroneas.csv, scrubbed the same way
real.hist_OC_erroneas.head.csv: Header, first 36 rows and the 4 July 2025 rows of https://transparenciachc.blob.core.windows.net/oc-da/hist_OC_erroneas.csv

synthetic.mp-api-licitaciones-dia.synthetic.json: Shaped from the documented licitaciones.json detail fields; codes, RUTs and names are synthetic. The real day listing may return a compact subset, so the schema keeps everything but CodigoExterno, Nombre and CodigoEstado optional
synthetic.mp-api-ordenesdecompra-dia.synthetic.jso: Shaped from the documented ordenesdecompra.json fields and the oc-da column names; codes, RUTs and names are synthetic
